candidate.definition_en: The process of closing a business and selling its assets to pay debts.
candidate.explanation_ar: تصفية الشركة، يعني بيع كل ممتلكاتها عشان تسدد ديونها وتقفل.

senses.definition_en: The process of closing a business and selling its assets to pay debts.
senses.definition_ar: تصفية شركة أو أصول مالية وتسويتها لسداد ديونها.
examples: The company went into liquidation last year.
Creditors demanded the liquidation of the firm's assets.
Following the scandal, the board voted for the immediate liquidation of the subsidiary.
